name: motor_yamnet_logistic

output.class_index: index into classes; use this rather than score argmax for SVC vote ties

contract.frontend: mono16 + four-second frozen YAMNet embedding mean
contract.window: three equally spaced4s nonoverlapping windows; model accepts one window feature vector; majority file/game vote outside model

encoder.pooling: arithmetic mean of 1024D frame embeddings, not 521 event scores

license.duplicate_relationship: The 20 WAV files are the decoded working copies of the same 20 M4A recordings with the first 2.0 seconds removed. Do not count formats as independent observations.
license.split: Five leave-one-speed-out folds: 100, 200, 500, 750, 1000 rpm. Each held-out speed contains both directions and both conditions, every source file's windows remain together.
license.identifiability_limit: One physical motor before/after rebonding and one source recording per operating condition. Speed transfer can be scored; unseen-motor, repeat-session and causal fault generalization cannot be established.

contract.limits: 20 WAVs from one physical motor; M4A counterparts excluded; no unseen-motor validation

training.selection: both fixed C=1 families retained, no outer-score winner selection

performance_claim: Deployment fitted on every cached observation. No deployment training-set accuracy presented as held-out performance.

verification_fixture.schema: features float32[N,D], scores float64[N,K], class_index int32[N], classes[K], source_indices[N]; <=8 real rows
